Create one exceptionally polished original GAME ART-DIRECTION CONCEPT IMAGE for FABLEWOOD, a 2D isometric elemental tower-defense game. This is a coherent producible gameplay-world illustration, not a movie poster, not a collage, not a sprite sheet, not a photo. Wide 16:9 composition with a fixed elevated orthographic isometric camera, clean painted 2D forms and consistent perspective. Art direction: ILLUMINATED GROVE. Sophisticated hand-painted gouache storybook illustration, broad elegant brushwork, subtle paper grain, clean soft dark contour lines, restrained atmospheric depth. All objects share the same handcrafted painted style. Palette: matte moss green #486A52, jade #234E45, parchment limestone #DED2AF, lantern gold #E8BC68, very dark indigo #202433. This should feel premium, warm and mysterious, not childish clip-art.

COMPOSITION: an open forest clearing with an unmistakably readable winding S-shaped ivory stone path crossing an isometric playable board from a broken ink-stained arch at upper left toward a small golden seed sanctuary at lower right. Keep path turns wide and unobscured. The board sits naturally in a woodland clearing with layered roots and a few low rocks, not a floating platform or an open book. Several subtle build pads of intertwined roots and worn pale stone sit beside the path, with clear space between them. Peripheral rounded tree canopies frame the scene without covering the board. Broad gentle upper-left light, localized small magical glows, attached soft contact shadows. Scenery low contrast and lower detail than units; restrained tiny fireflies only around the protected seed. Keep lower and right perimeters quiet for future real game UI.

ALLIED ELEMENTAL GUARDIANS: place four clearly separated, beautifully designed small guardian creatures on pads beside the path. FIRE: an ember-orange fox spirit with pointed ears, a curled flame tail and a warm lantern-like glowing chest; compact elegant silhouette. FROST: a rounded pale blue owl guardian with a crescent-shaped crystal feather crown, strong rounded silhouette and a calm gold-rimmed face. STORM: a slender lilac-and-indigo little stag guardian with short branching lightning antlers and a few flowing cloud tufts, clearly readable antler silhouette. EARTH: a broad moss-and-stone tortoise guardian, sturdy feet and a warm ochre stone shell with tiny leaves, clearly the low wide silhouette. Their feet/bases sit flush on the pads, never float. Keep all four similar game-piece scale, none an enormous hero portrait. Optionally one small merged owl guardian with crystalline wind-quills near the back to suggest existing elemental combination gameplay; do not overpopulate. Guardians are sculptural living woodland spirits, not humanoid soldiers and not stock pixel sprites.

ENEMIES: three small pointed-eared goblin-like creatures formed from torn living ink and one broader heavy ink-orc walk visibly along the pale path, with indigo-black bodies, ragged paper-like edges and restrained violet eyes. Include at most one small winged ink-dragon airborne just above a route segment with a detached ground shadow. Clearly separate hostile cool silhouettes from warmer friendly guardians. No blood, no horror gore, no armor clutter.

ENDPOINTS: both endpoints are visible. Entrance is a compact broken stone arch stained by flowing cool violet ink. Defended endpoint is a compact root cradle holding one luminous golden Last Seed, with four tiny elemental leaves around it. The seed sanctuary is the emotional focal point but must not hide surrounding play spaces.

TEXT: integrate a restrained tasteful small title at the top left, exactly FABLEWOOD, with the smaller subtitle ILLUMINATED GROVE — ART DIRECTION. Use a clean restrained sans-serif treatment, not ornate fantasy lettering. No other text, numbers, badges, fake HUD, panels, labels, logos or watermark. The real game will use live text separately.

AVOID pixel art, voxel cubes, photographic textures, glossy plastic, heavy 3D render look, noisy checkerboard tiles, stripe-like terrain, oversized guardians covering route cells, mismatched sprite styles, perspective drift, cropped subjects, explosive screen-filling effects, unreadable dark path, dense foliage in the gameplay area. Deliver an emotionally appealing yet practical visual target that could be built from separately generated 2D assets.
